scenario.name: r-cd-model-tool
scenario.description: continue_delegate typed tool form forwards an explicit model override to the delegate child.
scenario.notes: Alternate-model rows are blocked on karmaterminal/openclaw#1103 until the child runtime observes the requested model instead of inheriting gpt-5.5.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable k6 scenario exercises typed continue_delegate with explicit model override; authoritative model mismatch is FAIL-candidate and unavailable metadata is PARTIAL-candidate.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: report the current model identity from runtime context and the nonce only. The requested model is intentionally omitted from the child task to prevent echo-based false PASS. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed child provider/model byte from authoritative gateway child-session metadata or spawn record; child prose is auxiliary only

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: requested-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Committed request byte showing continue_delegate model=<provider/model>

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when the requested model byte matches authoritative gateway child-session metadata or spawn-record model bytes. The child task omits the requested model and its self-report is auxiliary only; mismatch is FAIL-candidate and unavailable metadata is PARTIAL-candidate.

census.limits: This row’s authority is deliberately not telemetry: the model byte comes from authoritative gateway child-session metadata, and the trace/session correlation receipt is optional. The census explains why that cannot change yet — an accepted entry span cannot be joined to the child run it produced, so telemetry cannot corroborate which child received which model. The row is separately blocked on karmaterminal/openclaw#1103.

spans.name: openclaw.model.call
spans.notes: Model-call spans exist fleet-wide; they cannot be attributed to a specific continuation entry.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
The requested override on the accepted entry span, so a later reader can compare request to the child’s observed model without trusting child prose.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Model and provider identifiers are published literally because they are public product identifiers. The requested model is withheld from the child task to prevent echo-based false PASS, and prompt bodies, session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: A committed request byte shows continue_delegate model=<provider/model> and authoritative gateway child-session metadata reports the same model.
controls.negative: The child task omits the requested model, so a child that merely echoes the expected string cannot produce a PASS; inheritance of the seat default is FAIL-candidate, not PARTIAL.
controls.notes: The negative control is the reason this row does not rest on telemetry: the only trustworthy byte is authoritative metadata, and telemetry cannot supply it today.

backendUnavailable.notes: The trace/session correlation receipt is optional, so a degraded backend does not by itself change this row’s class; unavailable authoritative child metadata does, and it is PARTIAL-candidate.

verdictAuthority.pass: The requested model byte matches authoritative gateway child-session metadata or the spawn record. Child prose is auxiliary and can never carry a PASS.
verdictAuthority.partial: Authoritative child metadata is unavailable, or the optional correlation receipt is missing while everything else holds.
verdictAuthority.fail: The child runs on a different model than requested, including silent inheritance of the seat default.
verdictAuthority.honestLimit: Not applicable. HONEST-LIMIT remains reserved for R-RC-2 below-threshold request_compaction refusal.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-model-tool.js fires the typed tool with an explicit override and reads authoritative metadata.
execution.manual: Manual runs may be used to confirm an alternate model is deployable on a seat before the row is fired.
execution.relationship: Deterministic k6 is the verdict authority. Manual confirmation is a precondition check and never evidence.

liveRunSafety.notes: Explicit model override row. Prevent echo-based false PASS by omitting requested model from the child task; authoritative fallback/inheritance is FAIL-candidate, while unavailable authoritative metadata is PARTIAL-candidate.
